items.question: Trong câu "An algorithm is a process, or a set of steps, that accomplishes a certain task.", từ "accomplish" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An algorithm is a process, or a set of steps, that accomplishes a certain task.", what does "accomplish" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: accomplish /əˈkʌmplɪʃ/ (động từ): hoàn thành. "Accomplish a task" = hoàn thành một nhiệm vụ; thuật toán là chuỗi bước giúp đạt được mục tiêu.
items.explanationEn: accomplish /əˈkʌmplɪʃ/ (verb): to complete successfully. "Accomplish a task" means to get it done; an algorithm is the series of steps that gets there.

items.question: Trong câu "Almost everything you do as a programmer — validating a form, paginating results, deduplicating a list — involves one.", từ "involve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Almost everything you do as a programmer — validating a form, paginating results, deduplicating a list — involves one.", what does "involve" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to include as a necessary part
items.explanation: involve /ɪnˈvɒlv/ (động từ): bao gồm, cần đến. "X involves Y" = X có liên quan/cần đến Y; hầu hết công việc lập trình đều cần đến thuật toán.
items.explanationEn: involve /ɪnˈvɒlv/ (verb): to include as a necessary part. "X involves Y" means Y is a necessary part of X; most programming work includes some algorithm.

items.question: Trong câu "They are the foundation of solving problems as a developer: turning a vague requirement into exact steps a machine can follow.", từ "foundation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They are the foundation of solving problems as a developer: turning a vague requirement into exact steps a machine can follow.", what does "foundation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: foundation /faʊnˈdeɪʃn/ (danh từ): nền tảng. "The foundation of X" = nền tảng của X; "foundation" cũng có nghĩa là quỹ/tổ chức từ thiện, nhưng ở đây là nền móng.
items.explanationEn: foundation /faʊnˈdeɪʃn/ (noun): the basis something rests on. "The foundation of X" is its base; "foundation" can also mean a charity, but here it means the base.

items.question: Trong câu "They are the foundation of solving problems as a developer: turning a vague requirement into exact steps a machine can follow.", từ "vague" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They are the foundation of solving problems as a developer: turning a vague requirement into exact steps a machine can follow.", what does "vague" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: vague /veɪɡ/ (tính từ): mơ hồ, không rõ. "Vague" trái nghĩa với "exact"; câu này đối lập yêu cầu mơ hồ với các bước chính xác.
items.explanationEn: vague /veɪɡ/ (adjective): unclear, not precise. "Vague" is the opposite of "exact"; the sentence contrasts a fuzzy requirement with precise steps.

items.question: Trong câu "They are the foundation of solving problems as a developer: turning a vague requirement into exact steps a machine can follow.", từ "requirement" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They are the foundation of solving problems as a developer: turning a vague requirement into exact steps a machine can follow.", what does "requirement" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: requirement /rɪˈkwaɪəmənt/ (danh từ): yêu cầu. "Requirement" thường gặp trong "business requirements" = yêu cầu nghiệp vụ mà phần mềm phải đáp ứng.
items.explanationEn: requirement /rɪˈkwaɪəmənt/ (noun): something that is needed. Common in "business requirements": the things the software is needed to do.

items.question: Trong câu "They are the core of technical interviews, where you are handed an unfamiliar problem and a blank editor.", từ "unfamiliar" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They are the core of technical interviews, where you are handed an unfamiliar problem and a blank editor.", what does "unfamiliar" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unfamiliar /ˌʌnfəˈmɪliə(r)/ (tính từ): lạ, chưa từng gặp. Tiền tố "un-" đảo nghĩa: "familiar" (quen) → "unfamiliar" (lạ); phỏng vấn thường đưa bài bạn chưa gặp.
items.explanationEn: unfamiliar /ˌʌnfəˈmɪliə(r)/ (adjective): not known or seen before. The prefix "un-" negates: "familiar" becomes "unfamiliar"; interviews give problems you have not seen.

items.question: Trong câu "The same algorithm can be written in JavaScript, Python or pseudocode; what defines it is the sequence of steps, and what we judge it by is correctness first, then efficiency (Big O, from topic 1).", từ "sequence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The same algorithm can be written in JavaScript, Python or pseudocode; what defines it is the sequence of steps, and what we judge it by is correctness first, then efficiency (Big O, from topic 1).", what does "sequence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: sequence /ˈsiːkwəns/ (danh từ): trình tự, chuỗi. "A sequence of steps" = chuỗi bước theo thứ tự; trong phim, "sequence" còn là một phân cảnh.
items.explanationEn: sequence /ˈsiːkwəns/ (noun): an ordered series. "A sequence of steps" is an ordered series; in film, "sequence" can also mean a scene.

items.question: Trong câu "The same algorithm can be written in JavaScript, Python or pseudocode; what defines it is the sequence of steps, and what we judge it by is correctness first, then efficiency (Big O, from topic 1).", từ "efficiency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The same algorithm can be written in JavaScript, Python or pseudocode; what defines it is the sequence of steps, and what we judge it by is correctness first, then efficiency (Big O, from topic 1).", what does "efficiency" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: efficiency /ɪˈfɪʃnsi/ (danh từ): hiệu quả, hiệu suất. Trong thuật toán, "efficiency" đo bằng thời gian và bộ nhớ (Big O); tính từ là "efficient".
items.explanationEn: efficiency /ɪˈfɪʃnsi/ (noun): how well resources are used. For algorithms, efficiency is measured in time and memory (Big O); the adjective is "efficient".

items.question: Trong câu "There are two complementary ways to improve:", từ "complementary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "There are two complementary ways to improve:", what does "complementary" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: complementary /ˌkɒmplɪˈmentri/ (tính từ): bổ sung cho nhau. Đừng nhầm "complementary" (bổ sung cho nhau) với "complimentary" (miễn phí/khen ngợi).
items.explanationEn: complementary /ˌkɒmplɪˈmentri/ (adjective): completing each other. Do not confuse "complementary" (completing each other) with "complimentary" (free or praising).

items.question: Trong câu "Devise a plan for solving problems — a repeatable process you run every time, so you are never staring at a blank page.", từ "devise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Devise a plan for solving problems — a repeatable process you run every time, so you are never staring at a blank page.", what does "devise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: devise /dɪˈvaɪz/ (động từ): nghĩ ra, lập ra. "Devise a plan/method" = nghĩ ra kế hoạch/phương pháp; khác với danh từ "device" (thiết bị).
items.explanationEn: devise /dɪˈvaɪz/ (verb): to invent or plan. "Devise a plan or method" means to work one out; not to be confused with the noun "device".

items.question: Trong câu "Devise a plan for solving problems — a repeatable process you run every time, so you are never staring at a blank page.", từ "stare" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Devise a plan for solving problems — a repeatable process you run every time, so you are never staring at a blank page.", what does "stare" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: stare /steə(r)/ (động từ): nhìn chằm chằm. "Stare at a blank page" = nhìn chằm chằm vào trang trắng, tức là bế tắc không biết bắt đầu từ đâu.
items.explanationEn: stare /steə(r)/ (verb): to look fixedly. "Stare at a blank page" means looking at nothing written, stuck on how to begin.

items.question: Trong câu "The process below is not a magical, fail-safe recipe — but it is reliably helpful.", từ "fail-safe" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The process below is not a magical, fail-safe recipe — but it is reliably helpful.", what does "fail-safe" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: fail-safe /ˈfeɪl seɪf/ (tính từ): chắc chắn không hỏng. "Fail-safe" = không thể thất bại/an toàn khi có sự cố; tác giả nói quy trình không phải phép màu.
items.explanationEn: fail-safe /ˈfeɪl seɪf/ (adjective): certain never to fail. "Fail-safe" means guaranteed not to go wrong; the author admits the process is no magic.

items.question: Trong câu "The process below is not a magical, fail-safe recipe — but it is reliably helpful.", từ "reliably" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The process below is not a magical, fail-safe recipe — but it is reliably helpful.", what does "reliably" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: reliably /rɪˈlaɪəbli/ (trạng từ): một cách đáng tin cậy. "Reliably" từ "reliable" (đáng tin cậy); "reliably helpful" = hữu ích một cách ổn định.
items.explanationEn: reliably /rɪˈlaɪəbli/ (adverb): in a dependable way. From "reliable"; "reliably helpful" means consistently useful.

items.question: Trong câu "It is adapted from mathematician George Pólya's classic book", từ "adapt" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is adapted from mathematician George Pólya's classic book", what does "adapt" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to change for a new use
items.explanation: adapt /əˈdæpt/ (động từ): phỏng theo, điều chỉnh. "Be adapted from X" = được phỏng theo X, có sửa đổi cho phù hợp.
items.explanationEn: adapt /əˈdæpt/ (verb): to change for a new use. "Be adapted from X" means based on X but changed to fit a new purpose.

items.question: Trong câu "The steps are not strictly linear: examples often reveal that you did not understand the problem, and refactoring may expose a bug.", từ "linear" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The steps are not strictly linear: examples often reveal that you did not understand the problem, and refactoring may expose a bug.", what does "linear" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: linear /ˈlɪniə(r)/ (tính từ): tuần tự một chiều. Ở đây "linear" = đi thẳng từng bước không quay lại; trong Big O, "linear time" là O(n).
items.explanationEn: linear /ˈlɪniə(r)/ (adjective): going straight in one order. Here "linear" means step after step with no going back; in Big O, "linear time" means O(n).

items.question: Trong câu "The steps are not strictly linear: examples often reveal that you did not understand the problem, and refactoring may expose a bug.", từ "expose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The steps are not strictly linear: examples often reveal that you did not understand the problem, and refactoring may expose a bug.", what does "expose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: expose /ɪkˈspəʊz/ (động từ): làm lộ ra. "Expose a bug" = làm lộ ra lỗi vốn đã có; trong API, "expose an endpoint" = mở ra cho bên ngoài dùng.
items.explanationEn: expose /ɪkˈspəʊz/ (verb): to bring to light. "Expose a bug" means to reveal one that was already there; "expose an endpoint" means to make it public.

items.question: Trong câu "Can I restate the problem in my own words?", từ "restate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Can I restate the problem in my own words?", what does "restate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: restate /ˌriːˈsteɪt/ (động từ): diễn đạt lại. Tiền tố "re-" = lại; "restate in my own words" = nói lại bằng lời của mình.
items.explanationEn: restate /ˌriːˈsteɪt/ (verb): to say again differently. The prefix "re-" means again; "restate in my own words" is to express it your way.

items.question: Trong câu "Can the outputs be determined from the inputs?", từ "determine" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Can the outputs be determined from the inputs?", what does "determine" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: determine /dɪˈtɜːmɪn/ (động từ): xác định được. "Be determined from X" = được suy ra/xác định từ X; "be determined to" lại là quyết tâm.
items.explanationEn: determine /dɪˈtɜːmɪn/ (verb): to be worked out. "Be determined from X" means worked out from X; "be determined to do" means resolved to do it.

items.question: Trong câu "You may not be able to answer this until you start solving — that is fine, it is still worth asking.", từ "worth" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You may not be able to answer this until you start solving — that is fine, it is still worth asking.", what does "worth" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: worth /wɜːθ/ (tính từ): đáng để làm. Cấu trúc "be worth + V-ing" = đáng làm gì, ví dụ "worth asking", "worth reading".
items.explanationEn: worth /wɜːθ/ (adjective): deserving to be done. The pattern is "be worth + -ing": "worth asking", "worth reading".

items.question: Trong câu "How should I label the important pieces of data?", từ "label" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How should I label the important pieces of data?", what does "label" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: label /ˈleɪbl/ (động từ): đặt tên, gắn nhãn. "Label" vừa là danh từ (nhãn) vừa là động từ (gắn nhãn); ở đây là đặt tên biến cho rõ.
items.explanationEn: label /ˈleɪbl/ (verb): to name or tag. "Label" is both a noun and a verb; here it means giving data clear variable names.

items.question: Trong câu "In an interview these questions become clarifying questions you ask out loud.", từ "clarify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In an interview these questions become clarifying questions you ask out loud.", what does "clarify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: clarify /ˈklærəfaɪ/ (động từ): làm rõ. "Clarifying questions" = câu hỏi làm rõ đề bài; danh từ là "clarification".
items.explanationEn: clarify /ˈklærəfaɪ/ (verb): to make clear. "Clarifying questions" help make the task clear; the noun is "clarification".

items.question: Trong câu "In an interview these questions become clarifying questions you ask out loud.", từ "out loud" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In an interview these questions become clarifying questions you ask out loud.", what does "out loud" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: out loud /aʊt ˈlaʊd/ (cụm từ): thành tiếng. "Ask/think out loud" = hỏi/nghĩ thành tiếng để người khác nghe thấy, rất quan trọng khi phỏng vấn.
items.explanationEn: out loud /aʊt ˈlaʊd/ (phrase): so others can hear. "Ask or think out loud" means voicing it so others hear, which matters in interviews.

items.question: Trong câu "The interviewer often leaves details out on purpose, to see whether you notice.", từ "on purpose" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The interviewer often leaves details out on purpose, to see whether you notice.", what does "on purpose" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: on purpose /ɒn ˈpɜːpəs/ (cụm từ): cố ý. "On purpose" = cố ý, trái nghĩa với "by accident" (vô tình).
items.explanationEn: on purpose /ɒn ˈpɜːpəs/ (phrase): intentionally. "On purpose" means deliberately, the opposite of "by accident".

items.question: Trong câu "Type and shape of the result — a number, a new array, a mutated array, an object?", từ "mutate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Type and shape of the result — a number, a new array, a mutated array, an object?", what does "mutate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: mutate /mjuːˈteɪt/ (động từ): thay đổi tại chỗ. Trong lập trình, "mutate" = sửa trực tiếp dữ liệu gốc; trong sinh học là đột biến.
items.explanationEn: mutate /mjuːˈteɪt/ (verb): to change in place. In code, "mutate" means modifying the original data; in biology it means a genetic change.

items.question: Trong câu "The lesson: even a trivial problem has decisions about input types, ranges and edge cases.", từ "trivial" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The lesson: even a trivial problem has decisions about input types, ranges and edge cases.", what does "trivial" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: trivial /ˈtrɪviəl/ (tính từ): tầm thường, dễ. "Trivial" = đơn giản đến mức tầm thường; "non-trivial" = không hề đơn giản.
items.explanationEn: trivial /ˈtrɪviəl/ (adjective): simple, unimportant. "Trivial" means very simple; "non-trivial" means it takes real effort.

items.question: Trong câu "The lesson: even a trivial problem has decisions about input types, ranges and edge cases.", từ "edge case" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The lesson: even a trivial problem has decisions about input types, ranges and edge cases.", what does "edge case" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: edge case /ˈedʒ keɪs/ (cụm từ): trường hợp biên. "Edge case" = trường hợp ở biên/giới hạn như mảng rỗng, số rất lớn, giá trị null.
items.explanationEn: edge case /ˈedʒ keɪs/ (phrase): an extreme input case. An "edge case" is an input at the limits, such as an empty array, a huge number or null.

items.question: Trong câu "Surfacing them first is cheaper than discovering them after the code is written.", từ "surface" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Surfacing them first is cheaper than discovering them after the code is written.", what does "surface" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: surface /ˈsɜːfɪs/ (động từ): đưa ra ánh sáng. Động từ "surface" = làm lộ ra/nổi lên; "surface an issue" = nêu vấn đề ra sớm.
items.explanationEn: surface /ˈsɜːfɪs/ (verb): to bring into view. As a verb, "surface" means to bring up; "surface an issue" means to raise it early.

items.question: Trong câu "Each unanswered question hides a real bug:", từ "unanswered" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each unanswered question hides a real bug:", what does "unanswered" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unanswered /ʌnˈɑːnsəd/ (tính từ): chưa được trả lời. "Un-" + "answered" = chưa được trả lời; mỗi câu hỏi bỏ ngỏ có thể thành một bug.
items.explanationEn: unanswered /ʌnˈɑːnsəd/ (adjective): not yet answered. "Un-" plus "answered" means not answered; each open question may become a bug.

items.question: Trong câu "What precision for floats?", từ "precision" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What precision for floats?", what does "precision" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: precision /prɪˈsɪʒn/ (danh từ): độ chính xác. "Floating-point precision" = độ chính xác của số thực, ví dụ 0.1 + 0.2 không đúng bằng 0.3.
items.explanationEn: precision /prɪˈsɪʒn/ (noun): degree of exactness. "Floating-point precision" is how exact a float is; 0.1 + 0.2 is not exactly 0.3.

items.question: Trong câu "Coming up with examples helps you understand the problem better, and it gives you sanity checks that your eventual solution works.", từ "come up with" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Coming up with examples helps you understand the problem better, and it gives you sanity checks that your eventual solution works.", what does "come up with" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: come up with /kʌm ˈʌp wɪð/ (cụm từ): nghĩ ra. "Come up with an idea/example" = nghĩ ra ý tưởng/ví dụ.
items.explanationEn: come up with /kʌm ˈʌp wɪð/ (phrase): to think of. "Come up with an idea or example" means to think of one.

items.question: Trong câu "Coming up with examples helps you understand the problem better, and it gives you sanity checks that your eventual solution works.", từ "sanity check" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Coming up with examples helps you understand the problem better, and it gives you sanity checks that your eventual solution works.", what does "sanity check" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: sanity check /ˈsænəti tʃek/ (cụm từ): kiểm tra hợp lý nhanh. "Sanity check" = phép kiểm tra nhanh xem kết quả có hợp lý không, không phải kiểm tra toàn diện.
items.explanationEn: sanity check /ˈsænəti tʃek/ (phrase): a quick reasonableness test. A "sanity check" is a quick test that a result makes sense, not a thorough test.

items.question: Trong câu "Coming up with examples helps you understand the problem better, and it gives you sanity checks that your eventual solution works.", từ "eventual" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Coming up with examples helps you understand the problem better, and it gives you sanity checks that your eventual solution works.", what does "eventual" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: eventual /ɪˈventʃuəl/ (tính từ): sau cùng, rốt cuộc. "Eventual" = cuối cùng sẽ có; bẫy: không có nghĩa "có thể" như "eventual" trong tiếng Pháp/Tây Ban Nha.
items.explanationEn: eventual /ɪˈventʃuəl/ (adjective): final, in the end. "Eventual" means happening in the end; it does not mean "possible".

items.question: Trong câu "In professional work, examples take the form of user stories and unit tests.", từ "take the form of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In professional work, examples take the form of user stories and unit tests.", what does "take the form of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: take the form of /teɪk ðə ˈfɔːm əv/ (cụm từ): có dạng là. "Take the form of X" = mang hình thức X, xuất hiện dưới dạng X.
items.explanationEn: take the form of /teɪk ðə ˈfɔːm əv/ (phrase): to appear as. "Take the form of X" means to exist or appear as X.

items.question: Trong câu "Simple examples — the smallest cases that show the basic behaviour.", từ "behaviour" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Simple examples — the smallest cases that show the basic behaviour.", what does "behaviour" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: behaviour /bɪˈheɪvjə(r)/ (danh từ): cách hoạt động. Với phần mềm, "behaviour" (Mỹ: "behavior") = cách chương trình phản hồi với đầu vào, không phải đạo đức.
items.explanationEn: behaviour /bɪˈheɪvjə(r)/ (noun): how something works. For software, "behaviour" (US "behavior") is how code responds to input, not manners.

items.question: Trong câu "More complex examples — mixed cases that force decisions.", từ "force" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "More complex examples — mixed cases that force decisions.", what does "force" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: force /fɔːs/ (động từ): buộc phải có. "Force a decision" = buộc phải ra quyết định; "force" danh từ là lực/sức mạnh.
items.explanationEn: force /fɔːs/ (verb): to make necessary. "Force a decision" means making one unavoidable; as a noun "force" means strength.

items.question: Trong câu "Invalid inputs — null, undefined, a number where a string was expected: throw, or return something safe?", từ "invalid" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Invalid inputs — null, undefined, a number where a string was expected: throw, or return something safe?", what does "invalid" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: invalid /ɪnˈvælɪd/ (tính từ): không hợp lệ. "Invalid" /ɪnˈvælɪd/ = không hợp lệ; đọc /ˈɪnvəlɪd/ (danh từ) lại là người ốm yếu, ít dùng.
items.explanationEn: invalid /ɪnˈvælɪd/ (adjective): not acceptable or correct. Stressed /ɪnˈvælɪd/, it means not valid; stressed /ˈɪnvəlɪd/, the rare noun means a sick person.

items.question: Trong câu "Invalid inputs — null, undefined, a number where a string was expected: throw, or return something safe?", từ "expect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Invalid inputs — null, undefined, a number where a string was expected: throw, or return something safe?", what does "expect" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: expect /ɪkˈspekt/ (động từ): mong đợi, dự kiến. "Expected output" = đầu ra mong đợi; "a string was expected" = lẽ ra phải là chuỗi.
items.explanationEn: expect /ɪkˈspekt/ (verb): to anticipate as correct. "Expected output" is what should come back; "a string was expected" means a string should be there.

items.question: Trong câu "Examples are also the fastest way to resolve ambiguity", từ "resolve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Examples are also the fastest way to resolve ambiguity", what does "resolve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: resolve /rɪˈzɒlv/ (động từ): giải quyết, gỡ bỏ. "Resolve ambiguity/an issue" = giải quyết sự mơ hồ/vấn đề; trong mạng, "resolve a domain" là phân giải tên miền.
items.explanationEn: resolve /rɪˈzɒlv/ (verb): to settle or clear up. "Resolve ambiguity or an issue" means to clear it up; in networking it means looking up a domain.

items.question: Trong câu "Examples are also the fastest way to resolve ambiguity", từ "ambiguity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Examples are also the fastest way to resolve ambiguity", what does "ambiguity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: ambiguity /ˌæmbɪˈɡjuːəti/ (danh từ): sự mơ hồ, đa nghĩa. Tính từ là "ambiguous" (mơ hồ); đừng nhầm với "ambition" (tham vọng).
items.explanationEn: ambiguity /ˌæmbɪˈɡjuːəti/ (noun): having more than one meaning. The adjective is "ambiguous"; do not confuse it with "ambition".

items.question: Trong câu "A handful of examples turned "count each character" into a precise spec: lowercase letters and digits only, only present keys, empty object for empty string.", từ "handful" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A handful of examples turned "count each character" into a precise spec: lowercase letters and digits only, only present keys, empty object for empty string.", what does "handful" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: handful /ˈhændfʊl/ (danh từ): một số ít. "A handful of X" = một vài X; nghĩa đen là một nắm tay.
items.explanationEn: handful /ˈhændfʊl/ (noun): a small number. "A handful of X" means a few X; literally, as much as a hand holds.

items.question: Trong câu "A handful of examples turned "count each character" into a precise spec: lowercase letters and digits only, only present keys, empty object for empty string.", từ "precise" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A handful of examples turned "count each character" into a precise spec: lowercase letters and digits only, only present keys, empty object for empty string.", what does "precise" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: precise /prɪˈsaɪs/ (tính từ): chính xác, rõ ràng. "Precise" = chính xác đến chi tiết; danh từ là "precision".
items.explanationEn: precise /prɪˈsaɪs/ (adjective): exact and clear. "Precise" means exact in detail; the noun is "precision".

items.question: Trong câu "These examples can later be pasted straight into tests:", từ "paste" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These examples can later be pasted straight into tests:", what does "paste" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: paste /peɪst/ (động từ): dán vào. "Copy and paste" = sao chép và dán; "paste into tests" = dán nguyên ví dụ vào bài test.
items.explanationEn: paste /peɪst/ (verb): to insert copied text. As in "copy and paste"; "paste into tests" means inserting the examples unchanged.

items.question: Trong câu "Explicitly write out the steps you need to take before writing real code.", từ "explicitly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Explicitly write out the steps you need to take before writing real code.", what does "explicitly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪsɪtli/ (trạng từ): một cách rõ ràng. "Explicitly" trái nghĩa với "implicitly" (ngầm định); viết rõ ra từng bước.
items.explanationEn: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪsɪtli/ (adverb): clearly and directly. "Explicitly" is the opposite of "implicitly"; spell every step out.

items.question: Trong câu "This forces you to think about logic before syntax and catches misunderstandings while they are cheap to fix.", từ "misunderstanding" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This forces you to think about logic before syntax and catches misunderstandings while they are cheap to fix.", what does "misunderstanding" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: misunderstanding /ˌmɪsʌndəˈstændɪŋ/ (danh từ): sự hiểu lầm. Tiền tố "mis-" = sai; "misunderstanding" = hiểu sai, "misread" = đọc sai.
items.explanationEn: misunderstanding /ˌmɪsʌndəˈstændɪŋ/ (noun): a wrong understanding. The prefix "mis-" means wrongly; compare "misread" and "misuse".

items.question: Trong câu "In an interview it also lets the interviewer correct your plan before you spend fifteen minutes coding the wrong thing.", từ "correct" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In an interview it also lets the interviewer correct your plan before you spend fifteen minutes coding the wrong thing.", what does "correct" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: correct /kəˈrekt/ (động từ): sửa lại cho đúng. "Correct" động từ = sửa cho đúng; tính từ = đúng. Người phỏng vấn có thể sửa kế hoạch sớm.
items.explanationEn: correct /kəˈrekt/ (verb): to fix what is wrong. As a verb "correct" means to fix; as an adjective it means right.

items.question: Trong câu "If a step feels vague ("handle the weird characters"), that is exactly where the difficulty lies — which leads to the next step.", từ "weird" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If a step feels vague ("handle the weird characters"), that is exactly where the difficulty lies — which leads to the next step.", what does "weird" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: weird /wɪəd/ (tính từ): kỳ lạ, bất thường. "Weird" là từ thân mật = kỳ quặc; ở đây chỉ các ký tự đặc biệt khó xử lý.
items.explanationEn: weird /wɪəd/ (adjective): strange, unusual. "Weird" is informal for strange; here it means special characters that are awkward to handle.

items.question: Trong câu "Simplifying is a deliberate technique:", từ "deliberate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Simplifying is a deliberate technique:", what does "deliberate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: deliberate /dɪˈlɪbərət/ (tính từ): có chủ ý. "Deliberate" = có chủ đích; cũng có nghĩa "thong thả, cân nhắc", còn động từ /dɪˈlɪbəreɪt/ là cân nhắc.
items.explanationEn: deliberate /dɪˈlɪbərət/ (adjective): done on purpose. "Deliberate" means intentional; the verb /dɪˈlɪbəreɪt/ means to think carefully.

items.question: Trong câu "Find the core difficulty in what you are trying to do.", từ "core" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Find the core difficulty in what you are trying to do.", what does "core" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: core /kɔː(r)/ (tính từ): cốt lõi, chính. "Core difficulty" = khó khăn cốt lõi; danh từ "core" còn là nhân xử lý của CPU.
items.explanationEn: core /kɔː(r)/ (adjective): central, main. "Core difficulty" is the central problem; as a noun "core" can also mean a CPU core.

items.question: Trong câu "Temporarily ignore that difficulty.", từ "temporarily" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Temporarily ignore that difficulty.", what does "temporarily" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: temporarily /ˈtemprərəli/ (trạng từ): tạm thời. "Temporarily" trái nghĩa "permanently"; tạm bỏ qua phần khó rồi thêm lại sau.
items.explanationEn: temporarily /ˈtemprərəli/ (adverb): for a short time. The opposite of "permanently"; set the hard part aside and add it back later.

items.question: Trong câu "Then incorporate the difficulty back in.", từ "incorporate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Then incorporate the difficulty back in.", what does "incorporate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: incorporate /ɪnˈkɔːpəreɪt/ (động từ): đưa vào, kết hợp. "Incorporate X into Y" = đưa X vào Y; "incorporated" (Inc.) còn là công ty đã thành lập.
items.explanationEn: incorporate /ɪnˈkɔːpəreɪt/ (verb): to include as part. "Incorporate X into Y" means to include it; "Inc." refers to a legally formed company.

items.question: Trong câu "For charCount, the fiddly parts are case and deciding what counts as alphanumeric.", từ "fiddly" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For charCount, the fiddly parts are case and deciding what counts as alphanumeric.", what does "fiddly" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: fiddly /ˈfɪdli/ (tính từ): lắt nhắt, rắc rối. "Fiddly" (Anh-Anh, thân mật) = lặt vặt, tỉ mỉ, dễ sai; gốc từ "fiddle" (vĩ cầm/mày mò).
items.explanationEn: fiddly /ˈfɪdli/ (adjective): small and awkward. "Fiddly" is informal British for awkward and detailed; it comes from "fiddle".

items.question: Trong câu "For charCount, the fiddly parts are case and deciding what counts as alphanumeric.", từ "alphanumeric" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For charCount, the fiddly parts are case and deciding what counts as alphanumeric.", what does "alphanumeric" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: alphanumeric /ˌælfənjuːˈmerɪk/ (tính từ): gồm chữ và số. "Alphanumeric" = alphabet + numeric: chữ cái a–z và chữ số 0–9.
items.explanationEn: alphanumeric /ˌælfənjuːˈmerɪk/ (adjective): letters and digits. "Alphanumeric" = alphabetic + numeric: the letters a–z and digits 0–9.

items.question: Trong câu "A working partial solution beats a perfect one that never gets written, and progress on the easy part often makes the hard part obvious.", từ "partial" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A working partial solution beats a perfect one that never gets written, and progress on the easy part often makes the hard part obvious.", what does "partial" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: partial /ˈpɑːʃl/ (tính từ): một phần, chưa đủ. "Partial solution" = lời giải một phần; "partial" còn nghĩa là thiên vị ("be partial to").
items.explanationEn: partial /ˈpɑːʃl/ (adjective): not complete. "Partial solution" means an incomplete one; "partial" can also mean biased.

items.question: Trong câu "A working partial solution beats a perfect one that never gets written, and progress on the easy part often makes the hard part obvious.", từ "obvious" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A working partial solution beats a perfect one that never gets written, and progress on the easy part often makes the hard part obvious.", what does "obvious" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: obvious /ˈɒbviəs/ (tính từ): hiển nhiên, rõ. "Make X obvious" = khiến X trở nên rõ ràng; trạng từ "obviously" = rõ ràng là.
items.explanationEn: obvious /ˈɒbviəs/ (adjective): easy to see. "Make X obvious" means to make it easy to see; the adverb is "obviously".

items.question: Trong câu "Now add the difficulty back — lowercase each character and skip anything that is not a letter or digit:", từ "skip" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Now add the difficulty back — lowercase each character and skip anything that is not a letter or digit:", what does "skip" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: skip /skɪp/ (động từ): bỏ qua. "Skip X" = bỏ qua X; trong vòng lặp tương ứng với lệnh "continue".
items.explanationEn: skip /skɪp/ (verb): to pass over. "Skip X" means to pass over it; in a loop that is what "continue" does.

items.question: Trong câu "Can you derive the result differently?", từ "derive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Can you derive the result differently?", what does "derive" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: derive /dɪˈraɪv/ (động từ): suy ra, rút ra. "Derive X from Y" = suy ra X từ Y; trong toán, "derivative" là đạo hàm.
items.explanationEn: derive /dɪˈraɪv/ (verb): to obtain by reasoning. "Derive X from Y" means to reach X from Y; in calculus "derivative" is a related term.

items.question: Trong câu "Can you understand it at a glance?", từ "at a glance" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Can you understand it at a glance?", what does "at a glance" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at a glance /æt ə ˈɡlɑːns/ (cụm từ): chỉ nhìn qua. "At a glance" = chỉ liếc qua là hiểu; code tốt nên đọc là hiểu ngay.
items.explanationEn: at a glance /æt ə ˈɡlɑːns/ (phrase): with one quick look. "At a glance" means with a quick look; good code should be understood immediately.

items.question: Trong câu "Clear names, shallow nesting, no unexplained tricks.", từ "shallow" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Clear names, shallow nesting, no unexplained tricks.", what does "shallow" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: shallow /ˈʃæləʊ/ (tính từ): nông, ít tầng. "Shallow nesting" = ít tầng lồng nhau; "shallow copy" = bản sao nông.
items.explanationEn: shallow /ˈʃæləʊ/ (adjective): not deep, few levels. "Shallow nesting" means few nested levels; compare "shallow copy".

items.question: Trong câu "Clear names, shallow nesting, no unexplained tricks.", từ "nesting" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Clear names, shallow nesting, no unexplained tricks.", what does "nesting" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: nesting /ˈnestɪŋ/ (danh từ): sự lồng nhau. "Nesting" = đặt khối lệnh trong khối lệnh (if trong for); nghĩa đen là chim làm tổ.
items.explanationEn: nesting /ˈnestɪŋ/ (noun): placing one inside another. "Nesting" means blocks inside blocks (an if inside a for); literally, building a nest.

items.question: Trong câu "Read other solutions afterwards to learn idioms.", từ "idiom" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Read other solutions afterwards to learn idioms.", what does "idiom" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: idiom /ˈɪdiəm/ (danh từ): cách viết quen dùng. Trong lập trình, "idiom" = cách viết phổ biến, tự nhiên của một ngôn ngữ; ngoài đời là thành ngữ.
items.explanationEn: idiom /ˈɪdiəm/ (noun): a common coding style. In programming, an idiom is a natural, common way to write something; in speech it is a saying.

items.question: Trong câu "for...of removes index bookkeeping.", từ "bookkeeping" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "for...of removes index bookkeeping.", what does "bookkeeping" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: bookkeeping /ˈbʊkkiːpɪŋ/ (danh từ): việc theo dõi lặt vặt. Nghĩa gốc là ghi sổ kế toán; trong code, "index bookkeeping" = việc tự quản lý biến chỉ số i.
items.explanationEn: bookkeeping /ˈbʊkkiːpɪŋ/ (noun): tedious tracking work. Originally accounting records; in code, "index bookkeeping" is manually managing the index i.

items.question: Trong câu "(result[char] || 0) + 1 collapses the if/else into one line.", từ "collapse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "(result[char] || 0) + 1 collapses the if/else into one line.", what does "collapse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: collapse /kəˈlæps/ (động từ): gộp lại, thu gọn. "Collapse X into one line" = thu gọn X thành một dòng; nghĩa thường là sụp đổ.
items.explanationEn: collapse /kəˈlæps/ (verb): to condense. "Collapse X into one line" means to condense it; the everyday sense is to fall down.

items.question: Trong câu "A helper isAlphaNumeric makes the intent readable at a glance.", từ "intent" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A helper isAlphaNumeric makes the intent readable at a glance.", what does "intent" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: intent /ɪnˈtent/ (danh từ): ý định, mục đích. "Intent" = mục đích của đoạn code; tên hàm tốt thể hiện rõ ý định.
items.explanationEn: intent /ɪnˈtent/ (noun): purpose, aim. "Intent" is what the code is meant to do; a good function name reveals it.

items.question: Trong câu "Regex tests are often measured slightly slower in loops, but this varies by engine — profile before assuming.", từ "slightly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Regex tests are often measured slightly slower in loops, but this varies by engine — profile before assuming.", what does "slightly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: slightly /ˈslaɪtli/ (trạng từ): hơi, một chút. "Slightly slower" = chậm hơn một chút; đồng nghĩa "a bit", "marginally".
items.explanationEn: slightly /ˈslaɪtli/ (adverb): a little. "Slightly slower" means a little slower; similar to "a bit" or "marginally".

items.question: Trong câu "Regex tests are often measured slightly slower in loops, but this varies by engine — profile before assuming.", từ "vary" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Regex tests are often measured slightly slower in loops, but this varies by engine — profile before assuming.", what does "vary" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: vary /ˈveəri/ (động từ): thay đổi, khác nhau. "Vary by X" = khác nhau tuỳ theo X; danh từ "variation", tính từ "various".
items.explanationEn: vary /ˈveəri/ (verb): to differ. "Vary by X" means it differs depending on X; related words are "variation" and "various".

items.question: Trong câu "Regex tests are often measured slightly slower in loops, but this varies by engine — profile before assuming.", từ "profile" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Regex tests are often measured slightly slower in loops, but this varies by engine — profile before assuming.", what does "profile" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: profile /ˈprəʊfaɪl/ (động từ): đo hiệu năng. Trong lập trình, "profile" = đo xem code tốn thời gian ở đâu; danh từ "profile" là hồ sơ.
items.explanationEn: profile /ˈprəʊfaɪl/ (verb): to measure performance. In code, "profile" means measuring where time is spent; as a noun it means a personal page.

items.question: Trong câu "O(k) for k distinct keys — at most 36 here, so effectively O(1)", từ "distinct" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "O(k) for k distinct keys — at most 36 here, so effectively O(1)", what does "distinct" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: distinct /dɪˈstɪŋkt/ (tính từ): khác nhau, riêng biệt. "Distinct keys/values" = các khoá/giá trị không trùng nhau; SQL có "SELECT DISTINCT".
items.explanationEn: distinct /dɪˈstɪŋkt/ (adjective): different from each other. "Distinct keys or values" means no repeats; SQL uses "SELECT DISTINCT".

items.question: Trong câu "O(k) for k distinct keys — at most 36 here, so effectively O(1)", từ "effectively" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "O(k) for k distinct keys — at most 36 here, so effectively O(1)", what does "effectively" (adverb) mean?
optionsEn: in a way that works well
items.explanation: effectively /ɪˈfektɪvli/ (trạng từ): trên thực tế. "Effectively O(1)" = thực chất là O(1); nghĩa khác là "một cách hiệu quả".
items.explanationEn: effectively /ɪˈfektɪvli/ (adverb): in practice. "Effectively O(1)" means O(1) in practice; the other sense is "in a successful way".

items.question: Trong câu "Refactoring did not change the Big O; it improved readability and constant factors.", từ "constant factor" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Refactoring did not change the Big O; it improved readability and constant factors.", what does "constant factor" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: constant factor /ˈkɒnstənt ˈfæktə(r)/ (cụm từ): hệ số hằng. "Constant factor" = hệ số nhân cố định mà Big O bỏ qua, ví dụ 2n và n đều là O(n).
items.explanationEn: constant factor /ˈkɒnstənt ˈfæktə(r)/ (phrase): a fixed multiplier. A "constant factor" is a fixed multiplier Big O ignores; 2n and n are both O(n).

items.question: Trong câu "Assume distinct values, so 3.", từ "assume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Assume distinct values, so 3.", what does "assume" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: assume /əˈsjuːm/ (động từ): giả định. "Assume X" = giả định X là đúng; "assume a role" lại là đảm nhận vai trò.
items.explanationEn: assume /əˈsjuːm/ (verb): to suppose. "Assume X" means to take it as true; "assume a role" means to take one on.

items.question: Trong câu "Remove duplicates, sort descending, take index 1:", từ "descending" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Remove duplicates, sort descending, take index 1:", what does "descending" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: descending /dɪˈsendɪŋ/ (tính từ): giảm dần. "Sort descending" = sắp xếp giảm dần; ngược lại là "ascending" (tăng dần).
items.explanationEn: descending /dɪˈsendɪŋ/ (adjective): from high to low. "Sort descending" means largest first; the opposite is "ascending".

items.question: Trong câu "The comparator matters: default sort() compares elements as strings, so [5, 10, 1].sort() returns [1, 10, 5].", từ "comparator" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The comparator matters: default sort() compares elements as strings, so [5, 10, 1].sort() returns [1, 10, 5].", what does "comparator" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: comparator /kəmˈpærətə(r)/ (danh từ): hàm so sánh. "Comparator" = hàm so sánh hai phần tử, như (a, b) => b - a truyền vào sort().
items.explanationEn: comparator /kəmˈpærətə(r)/ (noun): a comparing function. A "comparator" compares two elements, like (a, b) => b - a passed to sort().

items.question: Trong câu "We only need the top two values, so one pass tracking them is enough:", từ "track" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "We only need the top two values, so one pass tracking them is enough:", what does "track" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: track /træk/ (động từ): theo dõi. "Track X" = theo dõi X; cụm tương đương "keep track of X".
items.explanationEn: track /træk/ (verb): to follow and record. "Track X" means to keep following it; compare "keep track of X".

items.question: Trong câu "Dry-run it on [3, 8, 8, 5] to check the result by hand:", từ "by hand" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dry-run it on [3, 8, 8, 5] to check the result by hand:", what does "by hand" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: by hand /baɪ ˈhænd/ (cụm từ): làm thủ công. "By hand" = làm thủ công, không dùng máy; "deliver by hand" lại là giao tận tay.
items.explanationEn: by hand /baɪ ˈhænd/ (phrase): manually. "By hand" means manually; "deliver by hand" means handing it over in person.

items.question: Trong câu "A rough budget for a 45-minute problem:", từ "rough" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A rough budget for a 45-minute problem:", what does "rough" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: rough /rʌf/ (tính từ): ước chừng. "Rough estimate/budget" = ước lượng sơ bộ; nghĩa đen "rough" là thô ráp.
items.explanationEn: rough /rʌf/ (adjective): approximate. "A rough estimate or budget" is approximate; literally "rough" means not smooth.

items.question: Trong câu "A rough budget for a 45-minute problem:", từ "budget" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A rough budget for a 45-minute problem:", what does "budget" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: budget /ˈbʌdʒɪt/ (danh từ): phân bổ thời gian. "Time budget" = lượng thời gian được chia cho từng phần; nghĩa thường là ngân sách tiền.
items.explanationEn: budget /ˈbʌdʒɪt/ (noun): an allotment of time. A "time budget" is time allotted to each part; the usual sense is a sum of money.

items.question: Trong câu "Habits that separate strong candidates:", từ "candidate" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Habits that separate strong candidates:", what does "candidate" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: candidate /ˈkændɪdət/ (danh từ): ứng viên. "Candidate" = ứng viên; "strong candidate" = ứng viên sáng giá.
items.explanationEn: candidate /ˈkændɪdət/ (noun): a job applicant. A "candidate" is someone applying; a "strong candidate" is a promising one.

items.question: Trong câu "A narrated wrong turn can be rescued by a hint; a silent one cannot.", từ "narrate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A narrated wrong turn can be rescued by a hint; a silent one cannot.", what does "narrate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: narrate /nəˈreɪt/ (động từ): thuật lại thành lời. "Narrate" = kể/thuật lại; "narrator" = người dẫn chuyện.
items.explanationEn: narrate /nəˈreɪt/ (verb): to describe aloud. "Narrate" means to tell as you go; a "narrator" tells a story.

items.question: Trong câu "A narrated wrong turn can be rescued by a hint; a silent one cannot.", từ "rescue" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A narrated wrong turn can be rescued by a hint; a silent one cannot.", what does "rescue" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: rescue /ˈreskjuː/ (động từ): cứu vãn. "Rescue" = cứu; "a wrong turn can be rescued" = một bước đi sai vẫn có thể cứu vãn.
items.explanationEn: rescue /ˈreskjuː/ (verb): to save from failure. "Rescue" means to save; a wrong turn "can be rescued" means it can still be fixed.

items.question: Trong câu "A narrated wrong turn can be rescued by a hint; a silent one cannot.", từ "hint" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A narrated wrong turn can be rescued by a hint; a silent one cannot.", what does "hint" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: hint /hɪnt/ (danh từ): gợi ý. "Give/drop a hint" = đưa ra gợi ý; khác "answer" (đáp án đầy đủ).
items.explanationEn: hint /hɪnt/ (noun): a small clue. "Give a hint" means offering a clue, not the full answer.

items.question: Trong câu "State the brute force and its complexity first, then optimise.", từ "brute force" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "State the brute force and its complexity first, then optimise.", what does "brute force" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: brute force /ˌbruːt ˈfɔːs/ (cụm từ): cách vét cạn. "Brute force" = thử mọi khả năng, đơn giản nhưng chậm; nghĩa đen là sức mạnh thô bạo.
items.explanationEn: brute force /ˌbruːt ˈfɔːs/ (phrase): trying every option. "Brute force" tries every possibility, simple but slow; literally it means raw strength.

items.question: Trong câu "State the brute force and its complexity first, then optimise.", từ "optimise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "State the brute force and its complexity first, then optimise.", what does "optimise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: optimise /ˈɒptɪmaɪz/ (động từ): tối ưu hoá. "Optimise" (Mỹ: "optimize") = làm cho nhanh/tiết kiệm hơn; danh từ "optimisation".
items.explanationEn: optimise /ˈɒptɪmaɪz/ (verb): to make more efficient. "Optimise" (US "optimize") means making it faster or leaner; the noun is "optimisation".

items.question: Trong câu "Test by tracing, not just by saying "looks right".", từ "trace" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Test by tracing, not just by saying "looks right".", what does "trace" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: trace /treɪs/ (động từ): dò từng bước. "Trace the code" = dò từng dòng xem giá trị biến thay đổi thế nào; "stack trace" = vết ngăn xếp.
items.explanationEn: trace /treɪs/ (verb): to follow step by step. "Trace the code" means following it line by line; compare "stack trace".

items.question: Trong câu "Common mistakes: coding immediately, assuming inputs are valid and non-empty, silently changing the problem, forgetting to state space complexity, and stopping at the first solution without looking back.", từ "silently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Common mistakes: coding immediately, assuming inputs are valid and non-empty, silently changing the problem, forgetting to state space complexity, and stopping at the first solution without looking back.", what does "silently" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: silently /ˈsaɪləntli/ (trạng từ): mà không nói ra. "Silently change X" = lặng lẽ thay đổi mà không báo; "fail silently" = lỗi mà không báo.
items.explanationEn: silently /ˈsaɪləntli/ (adverb): without saying so. "Silently change X" means changing it without telling anyone; compare "fail silently".

items.question: Trong câu "An algorithm is a set of steps that accomplishes a task; judge it by correctness, then efficiency.", từ "judge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An algorithm is a set of steps that accomplishes a task; judge it by correctness, then efficiency.", what does "judge" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: judge /dʒʌdʒ/ (động từ): đánh giá. "Judge X by Y" = đánh giá X dựa trên Y; danh từ "judge" là thẩm phán.
items.explanationEn: judge /dʒʌdʒ/ (verb): to assess. "Judge X by Y" means to assess X using Y; as a noun, a judge works in court.

items.question: Trong câu "Examples go simple → complex → empty → invalid; they double as your test cases.", từ "double as" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Examples go simple → complex → empty → invalid; they double as your test cases.", what does "double as" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: double as /ˈdʌbl æz/ (cụm từ): kiêm luôn vai trò. "X doubles as Y" = X kiêm luôn vai trò Y; ví dụ kiêm luôn test case.
items.explanationEn: double as /ˈdʌbl æz/ (phrase): to also serve as. "X doubles as Y" means X also serves as Y; the examples also serve as tests.

items.question: Trong câu "When stuck, solve a simpler problem: ignore the core difficulty, solve the rest, then add it back.", từ "stuck" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When stuck, solve a simpler problem: ignore the core difficulty, solve the rest, then add it back.", what does "stuck" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: stuck /stʌk/ (tính từ): bế tắc. "Get stuck" = bị bế tắc; nghĩa đen là bị kẹt/dính (quá khứ của "stick").
items.explanationEn: stuck /stʌk/ (adjective): unable to progress. "Get stuck" means being unable to go on; literally it is the past of "stick".

items.question: Trong câu "Step 2 builds concrete examples that pin down behaviour and later become unit tests.", từ "pin down" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Step 2 builds concrete examples that pin down behaviour and later become unit tests.", what does "pin down" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: pin down /pɪn ˈdaʊn/ (cụm từ): xác định rõ. "Pin down X" = xác định chính xác X; nghĩa đen là ghim chặt xuống.
items.explanationEn: pin down /pɪn ˈdaʊn/ (phrase): to define exactly. "Pin down X" means to make it exact; literally, to fasten it with a pin.

items.question: Trong câu "Step 2 builds concrete examples that pin down behaviour and later become unit tests.", từ "concrete" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Step 2 builds concrete examples that pin down behaviour and later become unit tests.", what does "concrete" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: concrete /ˈkɒŋkriːt/ (tính từ): cụ thể. "Concrete example" = ví dụ cụ thể, trái nghĩa "abstract"; danh từ "concrete" là bê tông.
items.explanationEn: concrete /ˈkɒŋkriːt/ (adjective): specific, real. A "concrete example" is specific, the opposite of "abstract"; as a noun it means cement mix.
